description: We Are Never Ever Getting Back Together. The most annoying chorus of 2012. It's a chant, not a song. I've made entire careers out of a single hook, but this one's just noise. It's catchy, sure, catchy like a jingle. She was leaving country and didn't know what to grab. It worked commercially, so what do I know, but as the greatest artist I know a jingle when I hear one.
